company.name: BSE Limited
company.tag: Runs a stock exchange where shares are listed and traded, and sells data and a mutual fund ordering system
products: Trading in shares and index derivatives
Listing of companies’ shares and bonds
Sensex and other indices; price data
Clearing and settlement through a subsidiary
International exchange in GIFT City (India INX)
company.productNote: Services named in BSE Limited’s 2025–26 annual report. BSE Limited is the company that runs the BSE stock exchange; it is not the BSE Sensex index itself, which it publishes. Its subsidiaries (clearing, technology, index and the India INX exchange) are part of the group. Pictures are original illustrations: the report’s photographs are of company events, not of its services.
